newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia govt says fiscal target on track.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia govt says fiscal target on track.

text.p: Australian Assistant Treasurer Rod Kemp said on Wednesday the government still expected to meet its national public sector fiscal target.
The government said in its August 20 budget it would bring the public sector to a surplus of 1.3 percent of GDP by the end of the 1999/00 financial year.
"My belief is that this government will achieve its objectives," Kemp told parliament.

Asked if the target was unlikely to be met because of falling state government surpluses, he said: "Some of the surpluses in some of the states have been run down, but it is far too early to say, far too early to say, that we are not on target."

The government has temporarily reduced its subsidies to the states as part of the fiscal tightening announced in the budget, a move which the Labor opposition has said is responsible for the fall in surpluses.
The public sector reported a deficit of 1.6 percent of GDP in 1995/96. -- Canberra Bureau 61-6 273-2730
